docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-08-2020 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ERIKSSON, EDDIE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT NEBLETT, BERKELEY PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM FOR BAD FAITH DAMAGES FOR FAILURE TO REFUND APPROPRIATE PORTION OF SECURITY DEPOSIT WITHIN 21 DAYS IS DENIED. DEFENDANT RETURNED TOTAL AMOUNT OF SECURITY DEPOSIT INCLUDING APPROXIMATELY $900 OWED TO MASTER TENNENT. ALSO, DEFENDANT PRESENTED MEDICAL EVIDENCE SHOWING FAILURE TO RETURN SECURITY DEPOSIT IN 21 DAYS WAS NOT DONE IN BAD FAITH BUT BECAUSE OF MEDICAL CONDITION. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED APR-01-2020 ORDERED DESTROYED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $6,750.00 FILED BY ERIKSSON, EDDIE AS TO DEFENDANT NEBLETT, BERKELEY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-23-2019 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF ERIKSSON, EDDIE AS TO DEFENDANT NEBLETT, BERKELEY
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FEE: $85.75 SERVED DEC-04-2019, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT NEBLETT, BERKELEY
REQUEST TO POSTPONE SMALL CLAIMS HEARING FILED BY DEFENDANT NEBLETT, BERKELEY
(SC-152) ORDER ON REQUEST TO POSTPONE TRIAL GRANTED FILED BY DEFENDANT NEBLETT, BERKELEY AS TO PLAINTIFF ERIKSSON, EDDIE
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-23-2019 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT TO JAN-08-2020 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED UNSERVED AS TO DEFENDANT NEBLETT, BERKELEY

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JAN-08-2020 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JAN-08-2020 BY A. JAMES ROBERTSON II. PLAINTIFF EDDIE ERIKSSON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT BERKELEY NEBLETT IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
